cnTitle: 紫微斗数擎羊星：明枪式的刚猛，如何把冲劲变成竞争力
enTitle: Qing Yang in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Open-Blade Ferocity and How to Turn Drive Into Competitiveness
enDesc: Qing Yang is yang metal, qi of punishment, the fiercest and most direct of the four malefics, governing clash, decisiveness, blade energy and competition. Positively it is resolve, daring and hard skill; negatively impatience, head-on collision, injury and disputes. Strong and auspicious it converts punishment to courage, suiting police, surgery, engineering and competitive roles—the key is giving this blade the right place to work.
cnDesc: 擎羊属阳金、化气为刑，是四煞里最刚猛直接的一颗，主冲突、决断、刀光与竞争性，正面是果决、敢拼、技术过硬，负面是急躁、硬碰、外伤与官非。庙旺得吉可化刑为勇，适合军警、外科、工程、竞争性岗位，关键在给这把「刀」找对用武之地。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数陀罗星：拖延纠缠的暗劲，怎么破「原地打转」
enTitle: Tuo Luo in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Hidden Drag of Delay and Entanglement, and How to Break the Loop
enDesc: Tuo Luo is yin metal, qi of Ji (or punishment), the most sticky of the four malefics, governing delay, repetition, entanglement, chronic problems and hidden resistance, like a self-wound cocoon. It does not erupt but slowly grinds: positively endurance and deep stamina, negatively indecision, looping and chronic issues. Break it with deadlines, small steps and external pace.
cnDesc: 陀罗属阴金、化气为忌（一说为刑），是四煞里最黏滞的一颗，主拖延、反复、纠缠、慢性问题与暗中阻力，像蚕茧自缚。它不爆发，只慢慢磨，正面是耐力、深耕、能熬，负面是优柔寡断、原地打转和慢性病，破解靠设死线、拆小步、用外部节奏逼自己动。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数火星：闪电式的爆发力，怎么用好这股急性子
enTitle: Huo Xing (Fire Star) in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Lightning Burst Energy and How to Direct the Impatience
enDesc: Huo Xing is yang fire, qi of drain, governing suddenness, eruption, impatience and fast-come-fast-go energy like lightning. Positively strong action, quick reflexes, drive and on-the-spot burst; negatively impulse, short temper, disputes and sudden loss. With Tan Lang it forms the Fire-Tan sudden-wealth pattern; the key is an outlet for burst and a buffer for temper.
cnDesc: 火星属阳火、化气为耗，主突发、爆发、急躁与来得快去得快的能量，像闪电。正面是行动力强、反应快、有冲劲和临场爆发力，负面是冲动、脾气急、易起争执和突发破财，得贪狼成「火贪格」主横发，关键在给爆发力找出口、给急脾气装缓冲。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数铃星：闷烧的暗火，积蓄型情绪与韧性怎么疏导
enTitle: Ling Xing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Smoldering Inner Fire and How to Release Stored-Up Emotion and Resilience
enDesc: Ling Xing is yin fire, qi of drain, governing smolder, accumulation and cold-outside-hot-inside energy; unlike Fire's open burst, it presses emotion and pressure inward to a tipping point. Positively composure, resilience and staying power; negatively grudges, inner drain, hidden rivalry and sudden eruptions. With Tan Lang it is Bell-Tan; release depends on regular emotional outlets.
cnDesc: 铃星属阴火、化气为耗，主闷烧、积蓄、外冷内热的能量，和火星的明爆不同，它把情绪和压力压在心里慢慢累积，到临界点才爆发。正面是沉得住气、韧性强、后劲足，负面是记仇、内耗、暗中较劲和突如其来的发作，得贪狼为「铃贪格」，疏导关键在定期给情绪出口。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天巫星：升迁、继承与玄学缘分的四马吉星
enTitle: Tian Wu in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Four-Horse Auspicious Star of Promotion, Inheritance and Metaphysical Affinity
enDesc: Like Tian Ma, Tian Wu moves only through the four horse palaces, governing promotion, inheritance, ancestral blessing and metaphysical affinity—a star of being pushed forward or gifted. It cannot resist malefics itself and must attach to a strong major star and auspicious transformations to work, emptying with malefics—a classic assistant.
cnDesc: 天巫和天马一样只行寅申巳亥四马地，主升迁、遗产继承、祖上福荫与宗教玄学缘分，是一颗「被推一把、被赠予」的吉星，但它本身无力抗煞，必须依附有力主星和吉化才发挥，逢煞则空，属典型的佐曜。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天厨星：俸禄、口福与饮食行业的食禄星
enTitle: Tian Chu in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Salary-and-Palate Star of Food Blessing and the Food Industry
enDesc: Tian Chu governs salary and food blessing, palate and cuisine-related talent. In Life or Property it brings institutional benefits and no worry over food, plus discernment, enjoyment and cooking or tasting gift, clearer with Tan Lang or Ju Men Hua Lu; in Career it favors catering, food and nutrition industries.
cnDesc: 天厨主俸禄食禄、口福美食与饮食相关才华，入命或田宅主易得企业或机构的津贴福利、不愁吃穿，也主懂吃、会享受、有烹饪或品鉴天分，与贪狼、巨门化禄同会更明显，入官禄则利餐饮、食品、营养等行业发展。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数解神星：逢凶化吉、擅长解决问题的「解围星」
enTitle: Jie Shen in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Rescue Star That Averts Trouble and Solves Problems
enDesc: Jie Shen governs resolving, dispelling trouble and problem-solving. In Life one is optimistic, good at comforting others and empathetic, always finding room to turn trouble around; with malefics/Ji it acts as a cushion. It is auxiliary and cannot erase risks that should be avoided—first prevent, then resolve.
cnDesc: 解神主化解、消灾、解围与解决问题的能力，入命者乐天豁达、擅开导、共情力强，遇到麻烦总能找到转圜余地，逢煞忌时它像缓冲垫减轻冲击，但它是辅助星，不能让本该规避的风险凭空消失，重在「先防后解」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天官天福：官贵之气与天赐之福的一对安稳星
enTitle: Tian Guan and Tian Fu in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Pair of Steady Stars for Official Standing and Heaven-Sent Blessing
enDesc: Tian Guan governs official standing, integrity, culture and repute, favoring Life/Career and pairing best with a strong Tian Liang; Tian Fu governs blessing, longevity, luck and good fortune, favoring Tian Tong/Tian Shou. Both are gentle stability assistants—refined standing, blessing and security—whose force attaches to major stars, adding in a steady, long-flowing way.
cnDesc: 天官主官贵、清正、文化与名望，喜入命官禄、与庙旺天梁同宫相得益彰；天福主福气、寿命、侥幸与好运气，喜与天同、天寿同会。两星都是温和的安稳辅曜，主清贵、有福、生活有保障，力量需依附主星，属细水长流型加分。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数马头带剑格：擎羊在午，为什么反煞成贵、他乡立业
enTitle: Horse-Head-Bearing-Sword in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Qing Yang in Wu Turns Malefic to Rank and Builds Away From Home
enDesc: Horse-head-bearing-sword means Qing Yang guards Life in Wu, especially for Bing/Wu birth stems and without empty/Ji break; it refines the malefic's ferocity into martial rank—guarding the frontier, fame away from home, distinction in uniform or competitive fields, a classic case of a malefic in its right place converting to authority. Fallen and unrestrained it remains toil and injury; formation conditions are strict.
cnDesc: 马头带剑指擎羊在午宫守命，尤丙戊年生人、无空劫忌冲破者，反把擎羊的刚猛炼成武贵，主威镇边疆、异地扬名、武职或竞争性行业荣显，属「煞星得地、化煞为权」的典型；若落陷逢煞无制则仍是劳碌伤灾，成格条件很严格。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数君臣庆会格：紫微坐命、百官朝拱的领袖格局
enTitle: Ruler-Ministers Celebration in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Zi Wei Guarding Life With a Full Court of Assistants
enDesc: Ruler-ministers celebration means Zi Wei guards Life while Tian Fu, Tian Xiang, Zuo Fu, You Bi, Chang, Qu and Lu Cun court it across the trine without malefic break—leadership, strong organization and team support for management roles, better with Lu Cun; sparse assistants or malefics leave a lone ruler, greatly weakening the pattern.
cnDesc: 君臣庆会指紫微星坐命，天府、天相、左辅、右弼、文昌、文曲、禄存等百官在三方四正朝拱、且无煞冲破，主领袖气质、组织能力强、易得团队拥戴而居管理要职，加禄存吉化更佳；若辅曜稀少或逢煞，则只是孤君，格局大打折扣。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数武贪同行格：武曲贪狼在丑未，先贫后富的晚发格局
enTitle: Wu-Tan Together in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Wu Qu and Tan Lang in Chou/Wei, a Poor-First-Rich-Later Late-Bloomer
enDesc: Wu Qu and Tan Lang guarding Life in Chou/Wei is Wu-Tan together (it does not bloom in youth): Wu Qu's practical finance plus Tan Lang's desire and versatility mean early exploration, improvement after thirty and mid/late-life rise; with Fire/Bell it forms Fire/Bell-Tan sudden wealth. The key is caging Tan Lang's desire inside Wu Qu's discipline.
cnDesc: 武曲贪狼同守丑、未宫守命为武贪同行（武贪不发少年人），武曲的实干财星配上贪狼的欲望与多才，主年轻时多摸索、三十岁后渐入佳境、中晚年发越，逢火星铃星成火贪铃贪主横发，关键在把贪狼的欲望关进武曲的纪律里。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数廉贞贪狼同宫：巳亥宫的多才、欲望与自我管理
enTitle: Lian Zhen-Tan Lang in Si/Hai: Versatility, Desire and Self-Management
enDesc: Lian Zhen and Tan Lang guarding Si/Hai is Lian-Tan; both carry peach-blossom and desire, giving versatility, social skill, charm and sensitivity to art, entertainment and human dynamics. High energy but the greatest test of self-control: with auspicious transformations charm becomes career; with malefics/Ji/emptiness one indulges in pleasure with instability. The key is a high-grade outlet for strong energy.
cnDesc: 廉贞贪狼同守巳、亥宫为廉贪同宫，两颗都是带桃花与欲望色彩的星，主多才多艺、善交际、魅力强、对艺术娱乐和人情世故敏感，能量大但也最考验自控，逢吉化把魅力变事业，逢煞忌空劫则易耽于情欲享乐、起伏不定，关键在给旺盛能量找高级出口。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数巨机同临格：天机巨门在卯酉，善思辨、靠口才学问立身
enTitle: Ju-Ji Together in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Ji and Ju Men in Mao/You, Sharp Thinkers Who Build on Eloquence and Learning
enDesc: Ju-Ji together means Tian Ji and Ju Men guard Life in Mao (Mao over You), meeting Lu Cun, Hua Quan/Hua Lu and Zuo-You/Chang-Qu: agile thought, eloquence, strong research-analysis and memory, suited to academia, education, law, media and expert consulting, succeeding through speech and learning. With unrestrained malefics it becomes verbal dispute and much study, little result.
cnDesc: 巨机同临指天机、巨门同守卯宫（卯优于酉）守命，再会禄存、化权化禄、左右昌曲，主思维敏捷、辩才无碍、研究分析与记忆俱佳，宜学术、教育、法律、传媒、专业咨询，靠口才和学问名成利就；若会煞无制，则易变成口舌是非、多学少成。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数英星入庙格：破军在子午庙旺，破而后立的开创者
enTitle: Heroic Star in Temple in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Po Jun Strong in Zi/Wu, a Builder Who Breaks First
enDesc: Heroic star in temple means Po Jun guards Life strong in Zi/Wu; Po Jun governs breaking-old-to-build-new and change, and in its strong place converts destruction to creation—bold, reforming, able to rebuild from ruin or blank ground. With Lu/Quan and assistants it builds within breaking and rises through reform; fallen with malefics it breaks without rebuilding, churning in turmoil.
cnDesc: 英星入庙指破军在子宫或午宫庙旺守命，破军本主破旧立新、变动开创，得地庙旺则把破坏力化为开创力，主有魄力、敢改革、能在废墟或空白处重建局面，逢禄权辅曜则破中有成、越变革越上位，落陷逢煞则破而难立、动荡折腾。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数刑囚夹印：天相被廉贞擎羊夹，压力格局怎么读怎么解
enTitle: Punishment-Prisoner Clasping the Seal in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Tian Xiang Flanked by Lian Zhen and Qing Yang—Reading and Resolving a Pressure Pattern
enDesc: Punishment-prisoner clasping the seal means Tian Xiang guarding Life is flanked by Lian Zhen (prisoner) and Qing Yang (punishment), bringing heavy responsibility, institutional constraint, contract disputes or legal friction, and a tense, white-knuckled personality—a pattern needing active unbinding. With Lu/Quan/Ke and Kui/Yue harmonizing, pressure converts to professional authority; with heavy malefics/Ji, compliance and evidence are essential.
cnDesc: 刑囚夹印（刑囚夹印）指天相守命时，被廉贞（囚）与擎羊（刑）在两邻夹拱，主责任压力重、易遇制度性约束、合同纠纷或官非是非、性格易紧绷硬扛，是一个需要主动「松绑」的格局；得禄权科、天魁天钺调和则能把压力转成专业权威，逢煞忌重时尤须守合规、留证据。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数桃花诸格：泛水桃花、风流彩杖，桃花过重怎么读
enTitle: Peach-Blossom Patterns in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Water-Borne Peach and Romantic-Ribbon—Reading Excess Romance
enDesc: Tan Lang in Zi is water-borne peach, Tan Lang with Tuo Luo in Yin is romantic-ribbon—peach stars combined with specific palaces/malefics producing complex, fluctuating romance: strong charm and many suitors, rich love history but also emotional entanglement or reputational cost. Rather than labeling one flirtatious, see the pattern, direct social charm toward stable bonds and career, and actively manage relationships.
cnDesc: 贪狼在子为泛水桃花、贪狼加陀罗在寅为风流彩杖等，是桃花星与特定宫位、煞曜组合出的「感情复杂、情缘波动」格局，主魅力强、追求者多、感情经历丰富但也易因情生扰、纠缠或声誉受损，关键不是断人花心，而是看清模式、把人际魅力导向正缘和事业，主动做情感管理。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数三合派和飞星派到底差在哪，新手该怎么选
enTitle: San He vs Flying Stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Difference and How a Beginner Chooses
enDesc: The San He (southern) school stresses star combinations, brilliance/patterns and the trine, strong for character, talent and life tone; the Flying Stars (northern/Qin-Tian) school stresses stem transformations flying between palaces, strong for events, cause-effect and timing. Neither is right-or-wrong; modern practice often grounds with San He and predicts events with Flying Stars. Beginners should do San He first.
cnDesc: 三合派（南派）重星曜组合、庙旺格局与三方四正，擅长看性格、天赋与人生基调；飞星派（北派/钦天四化）重宫干四化的飞化往来，擅长看事件、因果与具体应期。两者不是对错关系，现代多以三合打底、飞星断事，新手应先三合后飞星。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数五行局详解：水二木三金四土五火六，决定大限几岁起运
enTitle: Five-Element Phases in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Water-2 to Fire-6 and How They Set the Decade Start Age
enDesc: The five-element phase is derived from the Life palace branch and birth-year stem (na-yin), into water-2, wood-3, metal-4, earth-5, fire-6; it sets Zi Wei's placement and the decade start age (2/3/4/5/6, ten years per palace), with a slight temperament tint. It is the key parameter for casting and decades; without it, decade direction and start age go wrong.
cnDesc: 五行局由命宫地支与生年天干（纳音）推得，分水二、木三、金四、土五、火六局，决定紫微星落宫和大限起运年龄（2/3/4/5/6岁起，每宫十年），也带一点性格底色。它是排盘和排大限的关键参数，不懂五行局，大限顺逆行和起算岁数就会全错。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命主身主是什么，排盘里到底怎么用
enTitle: Life Master and Body Master in Zi Wei Dou Shu: What They Are and How to Use Them
enDesc: The Life master is the star mapped from the Life branch (e.g. Life in Zi → Tan Lang), a general representative of innate pattern; the Body master from the birth-year branch governs later behavior and post-midlife direction. Their palace, brilliance and fortune help judge innate endowment and later focus; they are outline reference stars, not replacements for the twelve-palace reading.
cnDesc: 命主由命宫地支对应的星（如命宫在子命主为贪狼）取，是先天命格的「总代表」；身主由生年地支取，主后天行为与中年后走向。看命主身主所在宫位庙旺吉凶，可辅助判断先天禀赋强弱与后天着力点，它们是提纲式的参考星，不替代十二宫正解。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数小限怎么用：它和流年的区别与配合
enTitle: The Minor Limit in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How It Differs From the Year and How They Work Together
enDesc: The minor limit starts from the birth-year branch and advances one palace yearly, an inner one-age-one-palace trend focused on mental state, body and personal feeling; the year is set by that year's branch and focuses on external environment and actual events. San He often reads signs in the minor limit and facts in the year—inner and outer together are fuller than the year alone.
cnDesc: 小限以生年支定起、逐年顺行，是从本人角度看的「一岁一宫」内在运势，偏内心状态、身体与个人感受；流年以当年地支定，偏外部环境与实际事件。三合派常小限看迹象、流年断实事，两者一内一外配合，比单看流年更立体。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数暗合宫（六合）：藏在明盘背后的隐性关系线
enTitle: Hidden-Harmony Palace (Liu-He) in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Hidden Relationship Line Behind the Visible Chart
enDesc: The hidden-harmony palace uses branch six-harmony pairs (Zi-Chou, Yin-Hai, Mao-Xu, Chen-You, Si-Shen, Wu-Wei) to find the palace secretly corresponding to a given one—hidden resources, ties or mental activity influencing behind the scenes. The visible palace shows the surface, hidden-harmony the concealed tie, used for quiet help, hidden romance and true inner thoughts.
cnDesc: 暗合宫依地支六合（子丑、寅亥、卯戌、辰酉、巳申、午未）找某宫暗中对应的另一宫，代表台面上看不到、却在背后默默影响的资源、关系或心理活动。明宫看显性表现，暗合看隐性牵连，常用于看暗中助力、隐性桃花、内心真实想法。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数截空旬空（空亡）：让吉星打折、让事情落空的星
enTitle: Jie Kong and Xun Kong Voids in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Stars That Discount Auspiciousness and Empty Outcomes
enDesc: Jie Kong (including Xun Kong/Sky-void) governs sudden interruption, giving-up and falling-through; Xun Kong slow drain and looks-present-but-ungrabbable. These void stars discount co-located auspicious stars and derail plans, yet also buffer malefic/Ji harshness. Reading voids explains why good conditions still fall one step short.
cnDesc: 截空（分旬空/天空）主突然的中断、放弃与落空，旬空主缓慢的消耗与「看着有、抓不住」，它们属空亡类杂曜，会让同宫的吉星打折、让计划生变，但也能缓冲煞忌的凶性。读懂空亡，能解释「为什么明明条件好却差一口气」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数十四主星化禄差别：同样是化禄，得财方式完全不同
enTitle: How Each Major Star's Hua Lu Differs in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Same Gain, Different Path
enDesc: Hua Lu governs smoothness, gain and chance, but which major star it transforms decides what and how one gains: Wu Qu Lu is cash, Tai Yin Lu assets and hidden income, Tian Ji Lu ideas, Tian Liang Lu shelter-based gain, Lian Zhen Lu people and charm. Seeing Hua Lu is far from enough—star nature sets the earning path.
cnDesc: 化禄主顺遂、得到与机缘，但落在哪颗主星上，「得什么、怎么得」差别极大：武曲化禄是实财现金、太阴化禄是资产与暗财、天机化禄是点子生财、天梁化禄是荫蔽之财、廉贞化禄靠人际与魅力。只看「有化禄」远远不够，要看星性定得财方式。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数十四主星化忌差别：同样是化忌，卡点完全不同
enTitle: How Each Major Star's Hua Ji Differs in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Same Hook, Different Sticking Point
enDesc: Hua Ji governs attachment, blockage and inward gathering, but the star decides where and how one is stuck: Wu Qu Ji is cash-flow and decisional trouble, Tai Yin Ji emotion and female-relative worry, Tian Ji Ji overthinking, Ju Men Ji verbal dispute, Wen Chang Ji document error. Hua Ji must be read with star nature to reveal the real lesson.
cnDesc: 化忌主执着、卡点与内收，但落在哪颗星上，「卡在哪、怎么磨」截然不同：武曲化忌主资金周转与决断之困、太阴化忌主情绪与女性亲属之忧、天机化忌主想太多钻牛角尖、巨门化忌主口舌是非、文昌化忌主文书失误。看化忌必须连同星性，才知道真正的课题。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化权详解：掌控、行动力与压力的一体两面
enTitle: Hua Quan Explained in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Control, Drive and Pressure as Two Sides of One Coin
enDesc: Hua Quan is fire, governing control, expansion, action and say-so, strengthening and activating its palace. Positively boldness, responsibility, leadership and decisiveness; negatively dominance, control, pressure and going it alone. cnTitle: 为什么不同紫微斗数排盘软件结果不一样

cnTitle: 紫微斗数改运、补财库、开光物是真是假

enDesc: A chart shows tendencies and probabilities, not a fixed script; real fortune-changing reads those tendencies and adjusts choices, environment and behavior to maximize strengths and avoid risks. cnDesc: 命盘呈现的是倾向与概率，不是写死的剧本；真正的「改运」是读懂倾向后调整选择、环境和行为，把优势用足、把风险规避。花钱补财库、买开光物、做法事改命缺乏可靠依据，多为利用焦虑的商业套路；命理能帮你找规律，真正改变结果的，是你自己的行动。
